what: The syntax view, to match the pinned nightly (rust-lang/rust@16d1ffac). (1) A `box` pattern is removed syntax: the parser errors "`box` patterns have been removed (feature `box_patterns`)" at the `box` keyword, before cfg-stripping, with help "enable feature `deref_patterns` instead and...", a verbose suggestion removing `box` ("...if possible just remove keyword `box`..."), and a multipart suggestion "...otherwise replace it with an invocation of macro `deref`" (`deref!(..)`, with `field: ` first for a field shorthand); see compiler/rustc_parse/src/parser/pat.rs:1650 and 1939, diagnostics.rs BoxPatsRemoved. The test is blaze-diagnostics tests::items::features::gates::a_box_pattern_is_removed_syntax (upstream tests/ui/parser/removed-syntax/removed-syntax-box-patterns.rs: errors at lines 2, 7 and 10). blaze-diagnostics dropped its box_patterns gates (edit 72). (2) `type const` items are gone from rustc_parse and rustc_ast at 16d1ffac (only help text mentions them); blaze still parses them, and checks/features/gates (Pre::MgcaTypeConstSyntax, post.rs `type const` gates) still gate them on the removed min_generic_const_args. Say which parse error rustc gives, and I will drop those gates.
